description: Search Grafana dashboards and folders by title text.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of search results to return (default 100, clamped to 1-5000).

query.description: Optional title text to search for; dashboards and folders with a matching title are returned.

type.description: Optional Grafana search result type filter, such as 'dash-db' for dashboards or 'dash-folder' for folders.

name: search_dashboards
